connector.name: Artillery MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Artillery 2.x - full flags, Fargate, raw-text parser, project launcher (MIT)
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package artillery-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the kosiakmd account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ARTILLERY_WORKDIR
env.description: Absolute path to project root (walk-up from here finds .artillery-mcp.config.json).

env.name: ARTILLERY_CLOUD_API_KEY
env.description: Artillery Cloud API key. Forwarded to artillery CLI when record=true.

env.name: ARTILLERY_MCP_CONFIG
env.description: Absolute path to .artillery-mcp.config.json. Enables run_project_lt + counterBreakdown when set.

env.name: ARTILLERY_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Max duration of a single artillery command. Default 1800000 (30min).

env.name: ARTILLERY_MCP_CONFIG
env.description: Path inside container to config file.
